The River Park Farmers Market has been Fresno’s Favorite Certified Farmer’s Market for more than 20 Years! We celebrate the amazing bounty of our Valley and the hard work of the farmers that make it all possible. We also celebrate the bakers, chefs, and specialty food producers who create culinary magic with things grown right here in our Valley.

The River Park Farmer’s Market is a unique and delicious weekly experience that celebrates the diversity of the community we serve. A visit to the River Park Farmer’s Market is always a DELICIOUS adventure!

docs.description:
Vineyard Farmers Market offers the freshest locally grown produce available on a biweekly basis year-round.

Find everything from artisan-made chocolates and pastries to the freshest produce in season. 

Growers all farm within a two-hour drive of the market location, most within a 60-mile drive.Each operates a small family farm in Fresno, Madera and Kings County and are active in their local communities. All our growers agree to a farm tour of their properties prior to joining the market and every two years afterwards.  

Also visit the Vineyard Farmers Market on Wednesdays from 3 p.m. to 6 p.m.

Start your weekend with a run and a great crew! Join Fresno Run Club for our weekly Stride Social — every Saturday at 9 AM at 9407 N Fort Washington, Fresno, CA. 👟☀️

Whether you're training for a race or just want to get your body moving, this run is for all levels and all paces. We'll cover 1–3 miles, then hang around for post-run conversations, coffee, and community vibes. 💬☕️

✨ 1–3 mile run
✨ All paces + experience levels welcome
✨ Great way to meet local runners
✨ Monthly themed runs & pup-friendly events 🐾
✨ Supportive, no-pressure environment

Come solo or bring a friend — everyone is welcome! This is more than just a run… it’s a movement.

Follow us on Instagram for updates and run highlights: @fresnorunclub

docs.cms_title_sort: fresno scavenger hunt: fresno art & history (8467)
docs.description:
California's Central Valley grows grapes, organic vegetables and now, thanks to one city, art. On this culture-filled Fresno scavenger hunt, we make a loop around downtown in search of wondrous architecture, epic sculptures and great green spaces.

Which infamous fire inspired the Old Fresno Water Tower? Which American hero will you find chilling in Courthouse Park? Find out on this scavenger hunt of Fresno!

Some of what you'll see: Fresno City Hall, Old Fresno Water Tower, Fresno Memorial Auditorium

docs.description:
California's Central Valley grows grapes, organic vegetables and now, thanks to one city, art. On this culture-filled Fresno scavenger hunt, we make a loop around downtown in search of wondrous architecture, epic sculptures and great green spaces.

Which infamous fire inspired the Old Fresno Water Tower? Which American hero will you find chilling in Courthouse Park? Find out on this scavenger hunt of Fresno!

Some of what you'll see: Fresno City Hall, Old Fresno Water Tower, Fresno Memorial Auditorium

Whether you're a singing sensation or just looking to have a good time, this event is perfect for you. Grab the mic, pick your favorite song, and let your inner rockstar shine!
